annotation.interpretation_a: The ACK must be sent in the same protected packet that immediately follows the unprotected handshake packet.
annotation.interpretation_b: The ACK may be sent in any later protected packet, not necessarily the immediate next one.
annotation.justification: The clause does not specify whether the ACK must be sent in the same packet as the next handshake message or in any later protected packet, leaving a concrete missing constraint that allows materially different implementation behaviours.
